segments.ja512:1.1: Ko pāturāsī tidivā nabhamhi, obhāsayaṃ saṃvariṃ candimāva;
segments.ja512:1.3: Gattehi te rasmiyo niccharanti, sateratā [sateritā (sī. syā. ka.)] vijjurivantalikkhe.
segments.ja512:2.1: So chinnavātaṃ kamasī aghamhi, vehāyasaṃ gacchasi tiṭṭhasī ca;
segments.ja512:2.3: Iddhī nu te vatthukatā subhāvitā, anaddhagūnaṃ api devatānaṃ.
segments.ja512:3.1: Vehāyasaṃ gammamāgamma [kamamāgamma (sī. syā.)] tiṭṭhasi, kumbhaṃ kiṇāthāti yametamatthaṃ;
segments.ja512:3.3: Ko vā tuvaṃ kissa vā tāya kumbho, akkhāhi me brāhmaṇa etamatthaṃ.
segments.ja512:4.1: Na sappikumbho napi telakumbho, na phāṇitassa na madhussa kumbho;
segments.ja512:4.3: Kumbhassa vajjāni anappakāni, dose bahū kumbhagate suṇātha.
segments.ja512:5.1: Gaḷeyya yaṃ pitvā [pītvā (sī. pī.)] pate papātaṃ, sobbhaṃ guhaṃ candaniyoḷigallaṃ;
segments.ja512:5.3: Bahumpi bhuñjeyya abhojaneyyaṃ, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:6.1: Yaṃ pitvā [yaṃ ve pītvā (sī.)] cittasmimanesamāno, āhiṇḍatī goriva bhakkhasārī [bhakkhasādī (sī. syā. aṭṭha.)];
segments.ja512:6.3: Anāthamāno upagāyati naccati ca, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:7.1: Yaṃ ve pivitvā acelova naggo, careyya gāme visikhantarāni;
segments.ja512:7.3: Sammūḷhacitto ativelasāyī, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:8.1: Yaṃ pitvā uṭṭhāya pavedhamāno, sīsañca bāhuñca [bāhañca (pī.)] pacālayanto;
segments.ja512:8.3: So naccatī dārukaṭallakova, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:9.1: Yaṃ ve pivitvā aggidaḍḍhā sayanti, atho sigālehipi khāditāse;
segments.ja512:9.3: Bandhaṃ vadhaṃ bhogajāniñcupenti, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:10.1: Yaṃ pitvā bhāseyya ābhāsaneyyaṃ, sabhāyamāsīno apetavattho;
segments.ja512:10.3: Sammakkhito [samakkhito (sī.)] vantagato byasanno, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:11.1: Yaṃ ve pivitvā ukkaṭṭho āvilakkho, mameva sabbā pathavīti maññe [maññati (sī.)];
segments.ja512:11.3: Na me samo cāturantopi rājā, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:12.1: Mānātimānā kalahāni pesuṇī, dubbaṇṇinī naggayinī palāyinī;
segments.ja512:12.3: Corāna dhuttāna gatī niketo, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:13.1: Iddhāni phītāni kulāni assu, anekasāhassadhanāni loke;
segments.ja512:14.1: Dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ, khettaṃ gavaṃ yattha vināsayanti;
segments.ja512:14.3: Ucchedanī vittavataṃ [ucchedanī vittagataṃ (syā.), ucchedanivittagataṃ (ka.)] kulānaṃ, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:15.1: Yaṃ ve pitvā dittarūpova [duṭṭharūpova (sī.)] poso, akkosati mātaraṃ pitarañca;
segments.ja512:15.3: Sassumpi gaṇheyya athopi suṇhaṃ, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:16.1: Yaṃ ve pitvā dittarūpāva nārī, akkosati sasuraṃ sāmikañca;
segments.ja512:16.3: Dāsampi gaṇhe paricārakampi, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:17.1: Yaṃ ve pivitvāna [yañce pītvāna (pī.)] haneyya poso, dhamme ṭhitaṃ samaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vā;
segments.ja512:17.3: Gacche apāyampi tatonidānaṃ, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:18.1: Yaṃ ve pivitvā duccaritaṃ caranti, kāyena vācāya ca cetasā ca;
segments.ja512:18.3: Nirayaṃ vajanti duccaritaṃ caritvā, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:19.1: Yaṃ yācamānā na labhanti pubbe, bahuṃ hiraññampi pariccajantā;
segments.ja512:19.3: So taṃ pivitvā alikaṃ bhaṇāti, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:20.1: Yaṃ ve pitvā pesane pesiyanto, accāyike karaṇīyamhi jāte;
segments.ja512:20.3: Atthampi so nappajānāti vutto, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:21.1: Hirīmanāpi ahirīkabhāvaṃ, pātuṃ karonti madanāya [madirāya (pī.)] mattā;
segments.ja512:21.3: Dhīrāpi santā bahukaṃ bhaṇanti, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:22.1: Yaṃ ve pitvā ekathūpā sayanti, anāsakā thaṇḍiladukkhaseyyaṃ;
segments.ja512:22.3: Dubbaṇṇiyaṃ āyasakyañcupenti, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:23.1: Yaṃ ve pitvā pattakhandhā sayanti, gāvo kuṭahatāva na hi vāruṇiyā;
segments.ja512:23.3: [yaṃ ve pitvā pattakkhandhā, sayanti gāvo kūṭahatāriva; na hi vāruṇiyā vego, narena sussahoriva;(sī.)] Vego narena susahoriva [yaṃ ve pitvā pattakkhandhā, sayanti gāvo kūṭahatāriva; na hi vāruṇiyā vego, narena sussahoriva;(sī.)], tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:24.1: Yaṃ manussā vivajjenti, sappaṃ ghoravisaṃ miva [visamiva (syā.), visaṃ iva (ka.), visāmiva (?)];
segments.ja512:24.3: Taṃ loke visasamānaṃ, ko naro pātumarahati.
segments.ja512:25.1: Yaṃ ve pitvā andhakaveṇḍaputtā, samuddatīre paricārayantā [andhakaveṇhuputtā (sī. pī.), aṇḍakaveṇḍaputtā (ka.)];
segments.ja512:25.3: Upakkamuṃ musalehaññamaññaṃ, tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbhamimaṃ kiṇātha.
segments.ja512:26.1: Yaṃ ve pitvā pubbadevā pamattā, tidivā cutā sassatiyā samāya;
segments.ja512:26.3: Taṃ tādisaṃ majjamimaṃ niratthakaṃ, jānaṃ mahārāja kathaṃ piveyya.
segments.ja512:27.1: Nayimasmiṃ kumbhasmiṃ dadhi vā madhu vā, evaṃ abhiññāya kiṇāhi rāja;
segments.ja512:27.3: Evañhimaṃ kumbhagatā mayā te, akkhātarūpaṃ tava sabbamitta.
segments.ja512:28.1: Na me pitā vā athavāpi mātā, etādisā yādisako tuvaṃsi;
segments.ja512:28.3: Hitānukampī paramatthakāmo, sohaṃ karissaṃ vacanaṃ tavajja.
segments.ja512:29.1: Dadāmi te gāmavarāni pañca, dāsīsataṃ satta gavaṃ satāni;
segments.ja512:29.3: Ājaññayutte ca rathe dasa ime, ācariyo hosi mamatthakāmo.
segments.ja512:30.1: Taveva dāsīsatamatthu rāja, gāmā ca gāvo ca taveva hontu;
segments.ja512:30.3: Ājaññayuttā ca rathā taveva, sakkohamasmī tidasānamindo.
segments.ja512:31.1: Maṃsodanaṃ sappipāyāsaṃ [sappipāyañca (sī.)] bhuñja, khādassu ca tvaṃ madhumāsapūve;
segments.ja512:31.3: Evaṃ tuvaṃ dhammarato janinda, anindito saggamupehi ṭhānanti.
